name: Annotations
description: Version-bound notes and owner-contributed frozen text evidence

capabilities.title: annotations.write
capabilities.description: Freeze a complete owner-contributed text source or append an annotation revision with an original request receipt and CAS. Quotes use offsets within the selected preview inclusion. Does not modify scientific content, start a runtime, or send to an Agent. Capture/image import is not part of this text capability.

original_media.description: True only when these are the owner's original static media bytes.

selector.description:
Owner-defined identity and observed native version/digest. Preview must
revalidate these against the original source; never silently refresh them.

original_media.description: True only when these are the owner's original static media bytes.

capabilities.title: annotations.read
capabilities.description: Read principal/project-scoped annotation records and frozen evidence without observing a live source or starting a runtime. Exact historical note revisions stay readable; current source status remains unknown.

AnnotationAuthor.description: Authenticated author recorded by the containing call boundary, never model output.

oneOf.description: Authenticated principal; the transport does not claim whether a person or Agent initiated it.

original_media.description: True only when these are the owner's original static media bytes.

AnnotationEvidence.description: Owner evidence frozen when selecting or drawing begins. It never changes afterwards.

fragment.description: Only the selected bounded excerpt, never a backup of an entire object.

selection.description: The exact owner-issued reference used to observe the source again.

AnnotationListItem.description: A list row carries the frozen source identity so history can group by version.

current_version.description: The owner's current version when it could be observed; absent means unknown.

AnnotationSelection.description: Opaque, owner-issued source capture. This shape carries no Agent behavior.

AnnotationSession.description: Native observation identity; supplying it does not start or recover a runtime.

AnnotationSourceRef.description: The owner-issued content identity retained when an annotation is frozen.

source_id.description: Owner-native lineage identity, independent of the observed version.

source_version.description: Owner-native content version (hash, revision, observation or session identity).

capabilities.title: annotations.context.search
capabilities.description: Read principal/project-scoped annotation records and frozen evidence without observing a live source or starting a runtime. Exact historical note revisions stay readable; current source status remains unknown.

after.description: Opaque owner cursor; continuation does not imply a frozen multi-page read.

text.description: Empty text lists available sources. Owners document which fields match.

kind.description: A presentation hint supplied by the owner, not a closed core view enum.

selector.description:
Owner-defined identity and observed native version/digest. Preview must
revalidate these against the original source; never silently refresh them.

notices.description:
Explain partial, cached or unavailable observations without concealing
them as empty results. Completeness also belongs in the query envelope.

capabilities.title: annotations.context.preview
capabilities.description: Read principal/project-scoped annotation records and frozen evidence without observing a live source or starting a runtime. Exact historical note revisions stay readable; current source status remains unknown.

kind.description: A presentation hint supplied by the owner, not a closed core view enum.

selector.description:

data.description: Owner-defined bounded presentation data. Large artifacts use resources.

text.description: Plain text, never executable markup. Truncation must end at a UTF-8 boundary.

capabilities.title: annotations.capture.import
capabilities.description: Import a scoped immutable PNG/JPEG resource (at most 8 MiB) as a captured view, validating bytes, digest and decoded dimensions. Exact retries retain the receipt without rereading the source. Does not claim original scientific media or start a runtime.

original_media.description: True only when these are the owner's original static media bytes.

capabilities.title: annotations.capture.read
capabilities.description: Read up to 64 KiB of one exact retained capture without observing its original source or starting a runtime.
